title: Introductory Russian Studies I
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: You cannot enrol in this course if you have already previously taken RUSS1102.

title: Introductory Russian Studies II
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed RUSS1101 (previously RUSS1003), or have equivalent level of language proficiency as demonstrated by placement test, or with permission of the convener.
